rivalries.name: The Veteran Showdown
rivalries.narrative: A battle of transaction volume vs draft patience. Tim still boasts about extracting MacKenzie Gore (pick 243) and Trea Turner in 2024, while Dan relentlessly churns the wire to prove depth beats draft day.

rivalries.name: The Commissioner Clashes
rivalries.narrative: Adrian's pursuit of rotation workhorses directly clashes with Preston's radical relief-pitching monopoly. Every matchup between them is a philosophical referendum on starting pitching vs bullpen dominance.

rivalries.name: The Witt-Carroll Blockbuster Rivalry
rivalries.narrative: Born from the legendary 2025 trade where Mark sent Bobby Witt Jr. to Anil for Corbin Carroll and draft picks. Every week is an ongoing referendum on which cornerstone franchise talent delivered the bigger return.

rivalries.name: The Battle of Category Grinders
rivalries.narrative: Will's disciplined high-OBP approach meets Garrett's raw power-hitting arsenal. Usually decided by fractional OBP margins or Sunday night stolen base miracles.

season_storylines.title: 2026 Lineup Expansion to 28 Rounds
season_storylines.description: With the league expanding roster depth to 28 rounds, late-round draft capital and deep-bench management have never been more critical. Managers who navigated the expansion draft wisely hold a decisive depth edge.

season_storylines.title: The Closer & Reliever Arms Race
season_storylines.description: SV+HD has become the most contested roto category in the league. Preston's bullpen monopoly has forced managers like Will (acquiring Hader) and Dan to aggressively hunt setup men.

season_storylines.title: The Post-Trade Grading Reckoning
season_storylines.description: With the league's Trade Analyzer now grading all past trades with exact cumulative stats and drafted pick returns, past trade blunders and draft steals are on full display for daily trash talk.

trade_lore.summary: Dan sent Trea Turner & Pick #243 to Tim for Mike Trout, Pick #80, and $11 budget cash.
trade_lore.outcome: Tim turned Pick #243 into MacKenzie Gore (181 K, 11 QS, 110.7 pts), securing an A+ grade (+83.5 margin) while Turner posted 135.9 pts. Dan drafted Yandy Diaz (81.2 pts) at Pick #80.

trade_lore.summary: Mark sent Bobby Witt Jr. and Pick #235 to Anil for Corbin Carroll, Pick #52, and $4 budget cash.
trade_lore.outcome: Anil secured generational MVP talent Bobby Witt Jr. (186.0 pts) and struck gold with Nathan Eovaldi at Pick #235 (182.5 pts) for an A+ grade (+86.5 margin), despite Carroll delivering 222.8 pts (including keeper equity) to Mark.

trade_lore.summary: Adrian and Dan traded Pick #64 back and forth in multi-pick swaps.
trade_lore.outcome: Pick #64 yielded Tyler Glasnow (135.1 pts, 168 K, 14 QS), vastly outperforming the baseline pick curve.
